brief:
Ramallah — A real estate exhibition opened under the principal sponsorship and strategic partnership of Bank of Palestine, according to Ma'an news agency. The event marks a collaborative effort between the financial institution and the real estate sector in the Palestinian territories.

Details on the exhibition's scope, duration, and participating developers were not immediately available. Bank of Palestine's involvement signals continued institutional investment in the Palestinian property market amid broader economic conditions.
title: Palestine bank launches major real estate exhibition in Ramallah
